notes.title: Orange Life - Release
notes.content:
[h3]🚨 Official Launch Announcement – Orange Life Releases July 22! 🚨[/h3][p]Hey everyone!
After years of work, Orange Life is finally ready to hit the streets – and the [b]full version launches on July 22[/b]! 🔥[/p][p]🧡 [b]Orange Life[/b] is a chaotic, immersive open-world experience where [i]everything[/i] is interactive – from traffic lights and elevators to your own apartment. Complete missions, drive cars, explore the madness, and live the orange dream.[/p][p]🚗 Full game includes:[/p][list][*][p]New missions and features[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance & bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]A whole lot of chaos and surprises[/p][/*][/list][p]✅ [b]Until launch day, you can still play the FREE DEMO right now on Steam[/b] and get a taste of the action!
👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842430/Orange_Life/"]Play the demo here[/url][/p][p]📅 [b]Mark your calendars – July 22, 2025. Orange Life goes full release.[/b]
Thank you all for the support! This indie journey means everything.[/p][p]– One Dev, One Vision, One Orange Life[/p]
